title: Soul Born
description: Strives to bring an expansion to Minecraft's gameplay. Soul Born adds many items, structures, tools, enemies, and biomes to spice up Minecraft's core gameplay and overall feel. Better Combat is recomended to be used with this mod, but isn't required.
body:
Strives to bring an expansion to Minecraft's gameplay. Soul Born adds many items, structures, tools, enemies, and biomes to spice up Minecraft's core gameplay and overall feel. Better Combat is recomended to be used with this mod, but isn't required.

7 New weapon types
4 Block sets
5 Structures
That's all for now, but I will be updating this mod over time.
